cards.subject: a bright playful Montessori bedroom for a child aged 2 to 5, with a low birch toddler daybed and a crocheted play mat
cards.scene: A bright room with a pale ash floor. A sand crocheted play mat lies on the floor with a stacking ring tower and a small wooden train. On the RIGHT side wall, away from the mural: a low birch toddler daybed, 140 by 70 cm and only 35 cm high (below the child's knee), its long side against the side wall, with checkered and striped cotton bolster pillows in sand and oat. Crisp morning daylight from a window on the RIGHT falls in clear bright patches on the floor. Three small live butterflies in peach, butter yellow and pale pink fly in the air of the room in the sunbeam, clearly separate from the wall. A small girl of about four in a blush knit sweater and cream trousers stands barefoot on the floor in the middle of the room, about two metres from the mural wall and well away from the daybed, with her back to the camera, one arm raised toward the butterflies in the air in front of her, her face turned away from the camera so no facial detail is visible. Palette: oat, pale birch, warm cream, muted sage and white.
cards.framing: Shot from the left part of the room at eye level, turned about 25 degrees toward the mural wall, so the RIGHT side wall is in view. The frame shows a floor-to-ceiling section of the mural wall around the big pink and yellow cosmos flowers of the meadow: the ceiling line at the top of the frame, the skirting board and a strip of floor at the bottom; the mural continues beyond the frame edges at its true scale.

cards.subject: a warm playful Fun Haus bedroom for a child aged 6 to 10, with a low linen-cushioned daybed and an arch-front shelf
cards.scene: A golden room with a herringbone floor. A wool rug in blush pink and cream stripes lies on the floor, with a round dusty-rose pouf on it. On the LEFT side wall, away from the mural: a low cream Oliver daybed, 90 by 200 cm, with linen cushions, a blush-pink-and-cream striped bolster and a small sage cushion, beside it a low cream arch-front shelf 70 cm high with chapter books, and a small botanical print above. Warm golden sunlight from a window on the LEFT lies in amber patches on the floor. A girl of about eight in a cream hoodie and light trousers sits cross-legged on a cushion on the LEFT side of the room with her back to the camera, an open picture book on her knees, her face turned away from the camera so no facial detail is visible Palette: cream, blush pink, dusty rose and muted sage.
cards.framing: Shot from the right part of the room at eye level, turned about 25 degrees toward the mural wall, so the LEFT side wall is in view. The frame shows a floor-to-ceiling section of the mural wall around the big pink and yellow cosmos flowers of the meadow: the ceiling line at the top of the frame, the skirting board and a strip of floor at the bottom; the mural continues beyond the frame edges at its true scale.

clips.motion: The camera stays completely still on a tripod and does not move at all. A small girl of about four in a blush knit sweater and cream trousers slowly follows a butterfly with her raised hand. Her face is never visible to the camera, not even in profile: only the back of her head, her hair and her clothes are seen. She stays on the RIGHT side of the frame, far from the big pink and yellow cosmos flowers of the meadow, and never passes in front of the mural. The soft light stays constant.
